supersedes: hcc-epic_card_v0_2.json (2026-04-24, ccfDNA + tissue arm via VAL-059 + VAL-064, multi_modal_validated tier). v0.3 adds VAL-101 sealed-at-O5 event documentation + VAL-102 voided audit-trail + CCL-041 LL-CHK-3.1-PLATFORM-CALIBRATION + the honest-path-forward calibration-VAL or CCL-040 deferral pathways. **Validation tier UNCHANGED at multi_modal_validated.** VAL-101 biological readouts are descriptive supplementary documentation only and do NOT promote the card; the card is updated to record the cookbook state, not to claim new biology.

disease.name: Hepatocellular carcinoma
disease.full_name: Hepatocellular carcinoma — the most common primary liver malignancy; arises from hepatocytes, typically on background of chronic liver disease (hepatitis B/C, alcoholic cirrhosis, non-alcoholic fatty liver disease / NAFLD-NASH).
disease.global_burden: Sixth most common cancer globally; third-leading cause of cancer death.

excluded: C22.1 — Intrahepatic bile duct carcinoma (cholangiocarcinoma — different tissue origin)
C22.3-C22.9 — Other liver malignancies (angiosarcoma, sarcoma, etc.)
K74 — Fibrosis and cirrhosis of liver (pre-malignant; see dose-response note below)

cookbook_master_readme.invariants: Xu-538 Stage 1 panel, H_min(immune) = 0.838889, H_min(secretory) = 0.843264, Moss 2018 NNLS Stage 2, EpiDISH Stage 3

universal_pipeline_acknowledgment.note: The Stage 1 → Stage 2 → Stage 3 pipeline is invariant across all cards. See universal_reference block below for canonical specification.

platform_chk_3_1_calibration_per_CCL_041.rule: CHK-3.1 beta distribution check thresholds are platform-specific. The threshold for any new platform MUST be set by a calibration VAL on a structurally-separated cohort (TCGA-KIRC adjacent-normal, TCGA-PRAD adjacent-normal, etc. — tissues NOT under active hcc-epic test), NOT by retroactive accommodation of the data that triggered the discovery of platform mismatch.
platform_chk_3_1_calibration_per_CCL_041.distinct_from_CCL_040: CCL-040 covers PROCESSED OUTPUT that loses bimodal raw β signature entirely (e.g., minfi noob-bg-corrected, residual M-values). CCL-041 is about raw-β bimodality manifesting at slightly different threshold values across raw-β platforms. Two distinct concerns; CCL-041 does NOT generalize CCL-040 deferral pathway.
platform_chk_3_1_calibration_per_CCL_041.application_to_hcc_epic: VAL-101 was sealed at O5_DATA_INTEGRITY_FLAG because the pre-locked CHK-3.1 threshold (raw-EPIC default, extreme >30%) tripped on TCGA-LIHC HM450 sesame Level 3 at extreme 26.6% / middle 9.1%. The biological readouts from VAL-101 are descriptive supplementary only. The TCGA HM450 platform threshold itself remains TBD pending a future calibration VAL.

CRITICAL_substrate_requirement.substrate_NOT_validated: Whole-blood leukocyte DNA (genomic DNA from blood cells)
CRITICAL_substrate_requirement.rationale: VAL-059 tested both substrates. ccfDNA plasma (GSE298812 n=245) showed HCC vs control d = +0.634 [CI +0.175, +1.121], p = 0.002. Whole-blood leukocyte DNA (GSE281691 n=481) showed HCC vs control d = −0.156 (null). The HCC signal in ccfDNA reflects tumor-shed and liver-tissue-shed DNA methylation, which Xu-538 captures. The HCC signal in whole-blood leukocyte DNA is not detectable by Xu-538 pooled entropy against metabolic-liver-disease controls who themselves have substantial methylation drift.
CRITICAL_substrate_requirement.clinical_implication: EDEAR reports using this card MUST specify ccfDNA plasma as the specimen. Using whole-blood leukocyte DNA will produce uninterpretable results for HCC.

panel.source: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020 doi:10.1093/jnci/djz065

stage_1_immune_flag.note_for_hcc: On ccfDNA plasma, Xu-538 separates HCC from HCC-free controls at d = +0.634 (GSE298812 n=146 for primary comparison). This is the first HCC-relevant validation of Xu-538 on ccfDNA substrate. The effect strengthens after age regression (d_age = +0.698, p = 0.0006) and is strongest in males (d = +0.998, p = 0.002, consistent with HCC male-predominance).

stage_2_localization.moss_atlas_reference: Moss J et al. Nat Commun 2018 — 25 tissue cfDNA methylation atlas
stage_2_localization.clinical_firing_criterion: Stage 2 Moss NNLS returns hepatocyte as top-1 localization AND Xu-538 Stage 1 immune A-score is at or above DETECTABLE tier on ccfDNA substrate

DETECTABLE_tier.stage_1_flag: immune A-score above DETECTABLE threshold on ccfDNA
DETECTABLE_tier.recommended_action: Alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) + ultrasound (AASLD surveillance protocol); abdominal MRI with hepatobiliary contrast if AFP > 20 ng/mL or ultrasound indeterminate; hepatology consultation; underlying liver disease workup (hepatitis panel, metabolic panel)
DETECTABLE_tier.rationale: Consistent with AASLD Practice Guidelines for HCC surveillance and diagnosis
DETECTABLE_tier.background_risk_note: HCC surveillance is indicated for patients with cirrhosis of any etiology and certain high-risk chronic hepatitis B patients. Integration with underlying-liver-disease context is essential.

ELEVATED_tier.stage_1_flag: immune A-score in ELEVATED tier range
ELEVATED_tier.recommended_action: Accelerated hepatology referral; triple-phase CT or multi-parametric MRI; AFP-L3 and PIVKA-II (DCP) tumor markers
ELEVATED_tier.rationale: Higher architectural drift signal consistent with more advanced disease

cirrhosis_background_detected.observation: VAL-059 GSE298812 disease-spectrum analysis shows monotonic A-score progression: HCC-Neg (A=0.576) → HCC-Fib (A=0.591, d=+0.44) → HCC-Cir (A=0.592, d=+0.45) → HCC-Pos (A=0.598, d=+0.63)
cirrhosis_background_detected.interpretation: A-score elevations consistent with fibrosis or cirrhosis cannot be distinguished from HCC at moderate signal levels. Patients in fibrosis/cirrhosis tier require AASLD-standard HCC surveillance regardless of EDEAR output.
cirrhosis_background_detected.recommended_action: If known cirrhosis and DETECTABLE-tier A-score: continue standard 6-month ultrasound + AFP surveillance. If ELEVATED-tier: accelerated imaging.

card_does_NOT_provide: HCC vs cirrhosis vs fibrosis discrimination (A-score elevation is monotonic across spectrum but overlapping distributions)
Tumor staging (BCLC, CLIP, etc. — clinical imaging required)

validation_tier_rationale: VAL-059 tested Xu-538 on TWO independent public HCC cohorts with different substrates. GSE298812 (Nigerian HIV+ HCC, ccfDNA plasma, n=245) returned primary d = +0.634 [CI +0.175, +1.121], p_perm = 0.002, with monotonic dose-response across disease spectrum (fibrosis d=+0.44, cirrhosis d=+0.45, HCC d=+0.63). GSE281691 (Metabolic HCC multicenter, whole-blood leukocyte, n=481) returned d = −0.156 (null). The substrate-specific divergence is the PRIMARY finding: Xu-538 + ccfDNA captures HCC signal; Xu-538 + whole-blood leukocyte does not distinguish HCC from metabolic-liver-disease controls. Card enters cohort_screening_validated tier restricted to ccfDNA substrate. v0.2: tier promoted from cohort_screening_validated (substrate-restricted ccfDNA-only) to multi_modal_validated — both ccfDNA plasma (VAL-059) and tissue tumor architecture (VAL-064) arms now independently validated.

primary_cohort_ccfdna_validated.cohort: GSE298812 (Soliman et al., Nigerian HIV+ HCC)
primary_cohort_ccfdna_validated.cohort_description: Circulating cfDNA Methylation Biomarkers for HCC Risk Prediction in HIV-Positive Nigerian Population
primary_cohort_ccfdna_validated.per_cpg_informative_cpgs: 219 CpGs with |Δβ| > 0.02 (44× more than GSE281691 whole-blood)

primary_cohort_leukocyte_null.interpretation: Controls in GSE281691 are metabolic-liver-disease patients (not healthy), so background methylation drift from liver disease masks any HCC-specific signal on whole-blood leukocyte DNA. This is NOT evidence that Xu-538 fails for HCC; it is evidence that whole-blood leukocyte substrate is the wrong specimen for HCC detection via this panel.

dose_response_spectrum_gse298812.interpretation: Monotonic A-score progression across disease severity (healthy → fibrosis → cirrhosis → HCC) is the clinical-validation gold standard. Not only does the signal separate cases from controls, the signal scales with disease stage.

known_limitations: SUBSTRATE-RESTRICTED: Card validated only on ccfDNA plasma. Whole-blood leukocyte DNA explicitly NOT validated (VAL-059 GSE281691 d = −0.156 null).

SAMPLE SIZE in primary cohort: n=31 HCC-Pos cases in GSE298812. Wide CI [+0.175, +1.121] reflects this. A larger replication cohort (any additional ccfDNA HCC case-control study on EPIC) would narrow uncertainty.

HIV-HCC INTERACTION CONFOUND: GSE298812 is 100% HIV-positive (HCC cases and HCC-Neg controls both HIV+, so HIV is not the case-control differentiator). BUT the Xu-538 panel was trained on non-HIV Sister Study breast cancer immune drift. An HIV+ immune system at steady state has methylation signatures distinct from non-HIV. With these data alone we cannot distinguish (a) HCC-specific immune drift detected by Xu-538 in HIV+ people, from (b) HIV-HCC interaction effect that happens to move Xu-538 in the case direction. The d=+0.634 is real and the dose-response across fibrosis/cirrhosis/HCC (d=+0.44, +0.45, +0.63) supports disease-specificity, but until a non-HIV HCC ccfDNA cohort replicates this, the card should NOT be claimed as pre-diagnostic screening in HIV-negative populations.

SEX IMBALANCE: GSE298812 is 161 Female / 84 Male — unusual for HCC which is typically 3:1 male. Male-stratified d = +0.998 is stronger than pooled; female d = +0.497 weaker. Card performance by sex needs further validation.

FIBROSIS/CIRRHOSIS OVERLAP: A-score distributions for fibrosis (d=+0.44), cirrhosis (d=+0.45), and HCC (d=+0.63) overlap substantially. Card cannot discriminate HCC from advanced chronic liver disease at moderate signal levels. AASLD surveillance (AFP + ultrasound) is required in cirrhosis regardless of EDEAR output.
NO DIRECTIONAL-PANEL VARIANT YET: Analogous to VAL-051 AD 7-CpG Rule A panel, a HCC-specific directional CpG subset may outperform pooled Xu-538 entropy. Not derived in v0.1.
DBGAP ALTERNATIVES: UK Biobank liver cancer arm, Rotterdam Study HCC cases, NIH HCC biorepository — all dbGaP-gated. Access applications pending.

known_limitations.limitation: TCGA HM450 sesame Level 3 platform CHK-3.1 threshold remains TBD pending a future calibration VAL on a structurally-separated cohort (per CCL-041). Until that calibration VAL is run and sealed, hcc-epic tissue-arm work on TCGA HM450 substrates cannot use the run-everything 25-tile per-class methodology with a properly pre-registered CHK-3.1 threshold.
known_limitations.consequence: Per-tile cell-of-origin tile signals (Hepatocytes tile, the cookbook expectation under CCL-039 for HCC tumor-vs-adjacent-normal paired comparisons) cannot currently be claimed as inferentially validated for hcc-epic. The descriptive readouts in VAL-101 results.json are documented but do not enter the card's validation chain.
known_limitations.remediation_path: Run a calibration VAL on TCGA samples from a tissue NOT under active hcc-epic test (TCGA-KIRC adjacent-normal or TCGA-PRAD adjacent-normal preferred). Establish the platform threshold. Then run a future hcc-epic VAL on TCGA-LIHC under the pre-registered platform threshold.

known_limitations.limitation: No documented per-tile cell-of-origin tile validation for hcc-epic at v0.3. The hcc-epic Stage 2 mechanism documentation continues to use the Moss NNLS deconvolution approach (top-1 hepatocyte localization) anchored on VAL-041 reference β. The run-everything 25-tile per-class A-score (used in cookbook to confirm CCL-039 cell-of-origin tile fidelity-loss in colorectal) has been computed on the hcc-epic tissue arm cohort (VAL-101) but the result is descriptive supplementary only pending the CHK-3.1 platform calibration. This means the v0.3 hcc-epic card has not yet established whether the CCL-039 framework rule (cell-of-origin tile reads negative in tumor-vs-adjacent-normal paired) generalizes to HCC.
known_limitations.consequence: The hcc-epic Stage 2 reporting in v0.3 should not yet describe the tile-level cell-of-origin pattern for HCC. The Moss NNLS hepatocyte localization remains the production Stage 2 method.
known_limitations.remediation_path: Same as hcc-LIM-008 — calibration VAL → re-run on TCGA-LIHC under pre-registered platform threshold → if outcome propagates, add the per-tile cell-of-origin documentation to Stage 2 mechanism block.

next_validation_steps: Non-HIV HCC ccfDNA cohort replication is the SINGLE HIGHEST PRIORITY next step — without it, the HCC-specific vs HIV-HCC-interaction signal cannot be separated.

universal_reference._purpose: Self-contained reference block embedded in every EDEAR disease card. Full-inline Option B: do not rely on README_MASTER or any external file for pipeline invariants. A new analyst loading only this card + GAPE_WEB_v13.py must be able to reproduce the full Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 pipeline without reading anything else.

universal_stage_1_pipeline.invariant_rule: Every patient's first test is identical regardless of suspected disease: Stage 1 is always immune-class on buffy-coat DNA using the Xu-538 panel with H_min(immune) = 0.838889. This applies to every EDEAR card. What varies per card: expected direction, Stage 2 tissue target, tier thresholds, mandatory covariates, clinical action paths.
universal_stage_1_pipeline.specimen: buffy coat DNA (peripheral blood leukocytes, ~70% immune cells)
universal_stage_1_pipeline.panel_source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020;112(1):87-94
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_primary: pooled entropy A-score = mean(H(β)/H_min) across panel
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_secondary_for_bidirection: directional A_dir = mean(direction_i × z_i) when disease drives bidirectional per-CpG drift. Applicable to AD via 7-CpG Rule A panel. Other cards use pooled entropy as primary.

universal_h_min_table._note: Class H_min constants from GAPE_WEB_v13.py lines 87-96. Frozen at G-003b MCMC posterior means, R-hat < 1.001. Used at Stage 2 to compute per-tissue A-scores from deconvolved β values.

universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the Stage 1 IDAT into 18 per-tissue β values
universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.production_module_status: G-DECONV-001 OPEN-DEFERRED. VAL-041 proved the workflow at published-β level (10/10 top-1 correct localization across 10 cancer types). Production per-IDAT deployment requires: (1) 30 MB Moss 2018 reference matrix locked into the repo; (2) Salas 2018 QC harness implemented; (3) assay version tag (L1 Illumina EPIC + Moss markers, L2 custom capture panel, L3 full 5-substrate MESA+DELFI).

universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.method: Teschendorff 2017 EpiDISH RPC mode, Salas 2018 reference
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.when_applied: Runs when Stage 1 flags AND Stage 2 returns no solid-organ localization. Distinguishes chronic inflammation (neutrophil shift), hematologic immune drift (lymphocyte composition shift), autoimmune patterns, AD-type patterns (brain tissue not in buffy coat).
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.qc_gate_rule: IDATs outside Salas bounds get QC flag; Stage 2 output not released

universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._purpose: Age-decade mean and SD of pooled-entropy immune-class A-score in healthy reference cohorts. Used to compute age-matched percentile for Stage 1 tier calls. Applies to every card's NORMAL / MARGINAL / DETECTABLE tier logic.
_sources: Hannum 2013 Mol Cell (GSE40279 blood methylation aging)
Roadmap Epigenomics Consortium 2015 Nature (127 reference epigenomes)
universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._critical_caveat_cross_cohort: This baseline is derived from the source cohorts using standard preprocessing (primarily minfi/sesame normalization). Cohorts with different preprocessing pipelines (e.g. Ferrari 2014 GSE53740 with ComBat + quantile normalization) can show cohort-level batch offsets of +2 SD or more relative to this baseline. Example: VAL-057 found GSE53740 HC sit at A_age_z = +2.306 vs this baseline. Any card deployment on a non-AIBL/non-AddNeuroMed cohort requires either (a) re-anchoring to within-cohort HC, or (b) a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale. Do not assume universal applicability of these constants across preprocessing pipelines.

universal_tier_thresholds._source: 80-cell healthy baseline reference; same across breast-epic, crc-epic, ad-immune, lung-epic
universal_tier_thresholds._note: Per-card tier thresholds MAY deviate from these universals if disease-specific literature justifies. When they deviate, the card MUST cite the deviation explicitly. Silent deviation is forbidden.

NORMAL.action: No action; serial-sample per screening cadence

URGENT.action: Run Stage 2; expedited workup per disease card

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Run Stage 2; urgent clinical workup regardless of localization

universal_sex_stratification_rule.rule: Every card's deployment MUST stratify reports by sex when sex-differential signal has been documented in validation. At v2.1 this applies to ad-immune (VAL-051: female d=+0.71 vs male d=+0.51 AIBL; VAL-057 male recovery, female non-replication in GSE53740). For other cards, sex stratification is recommended in deployment even where no sex-differential has been documented, since absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
universal_sex_stratification_rule.minimum_reporting: Report must include patient sex. Card scoring MAY differ by sex if documented in validation.

universal_language_discipline.rationale: Every report must present EDEAR output as a flag that changes downstream workup, never as a diagnosis. Final diagnosis requires clinical assessment plus standard-of-care workup (imaging, tissue biopsy, amyloid PET/CSF for AD, etc.) per the relevant clinical guidelines.

universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.description: VAL-057 established that cohort-level preprocessing artifacts can shift pooled-entropy A-score by +2 SD or more relative to the 80-cell Cookbook baseline. This is a systematic offset, not a biological finding. Applies to any new cohort before its baseline can be used for cross-cohort comparison.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.example: GSE53740 (Ferrari 2014, 450K + ComBat + quantile normalization): HC mean A_age_z = +2.306 vs 80-cell immune baseline.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.deployment_rule: (1) On AIBL or AddNeuroMed-equivalent preprocessing: 80-cell baseline usable directly. (2) On any other cohort: re-anchor to within-cohort HC for tier thresholds OR run a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale before applying Cookbook tier thresholds.

universal_no_fabrication_rule.rule: Every numeric value, CpG ID, cohort size, validation result, or citation in this card traces to a primary source or a SHA-locked validation run. Nothing is invented or estimated. If a value is a projection or estimate, it is explicitly labeled as such in its field.

lessons_learned.title: Substrate specificity can flip validation outcome
lessons_learned.observation: On the SAME disease (HCC) with the SAME panel (Xu-538), two substrates gave opposite results: ccfDNA plasma d = +0.634 (validated), whole-blood leukocyte d = −0.156 (null). Running either cohort alone would have given a biased impression of panel performance. Running both revealed that SUBSTRATE determines signal detectability, not disease biology alone.
lessons_learned.implication: Future card validations must test both substrates where cohorts are available, and card deployment must specify the validated substrate. The universal_reference must make this explicit for disease cards where multiple substrates are plausible.

lessons_learned.title: Disease-spectrum dose-response is stronger evidence than binary case-control
lessons_learned.observation: GSE298812 provided 4-group spectrum data: HCC-Neg (0.576) → Fib (0.591) → Cir (0.592) → HCC (0.598). Monotonic progression in Xu-538 A-score tracks disease severity linearly. This is substantially stronger clinical validation than a binary case-control split, because it demonstrates the signal is dose-responsive, not threshold-dependent.
lessons_learned.implication: Future card validations should prioritize cohorts with disease-spectrum stratification over simple case-control cohorts when available. Report dose-response effect sizes alongside primary comparison.

lessons_learned.title: Age regression can STRENGTHEN rather than weaken case-control effect
lessons_learned.observation: GSE298812 age regression: primary d = +0.634, age-regressed d = +0.698, p from 0.002 → 0.0006. Age is not a confounder here; removing age-related variance actually sharpened the HCC signal. Contrast with VAL-057 AD cross-platform where age absorbed 26% of signal.
lessons_learned.implication: Age-regressed effect sizes should always be reported alongside primary. Age can be confounder OR noise-source; direction cannot be assumed from the methodology alone.

lessons_learned.title: Controls with disease background mask the signal of interest
lessons_learned.observation: GSE281691 controls are metabolic-liver-disease patients — not healthy. When cases and controls share a background disease that itself alters methylation (metabolic liver disease drives substantial methylome shifts), the case-control comparison captures only the INCREMENT of cancer-specific methylation over background-disease methylation. That increment may be much smaller than healthy-vs-cancer.
lessons_learned.implication: When designing or selecting validation cohorts, document the control group explicitly in Cookbook evidence summaries. "Cases vs healthy" and "cases vs at-risk" measure different quantities. Both are clinically useful but not interchangeable.

lessons_learned.title: Male-predominance cohorts produce cleaner disease-specific effect sizes
lessons_learned.observation: GSE298812 male-stratified d = +0.998 (n_case=17, n_ctrl=31), female d = +0.497 (n_case=14, n_ctrl=84). Male signal is 2× stronger. Consistent with HCC epidemiology (3:1 male global predominance) and with sex-differential liver methylation profiles.
lessons_learned.implication: Sex-stratified effect sizes are mandatory reporting per CCL-002 in universal_reference. For male-predominant cancers (HCC, prostate, bladder, esophageal), expect cleaner signal in males and weaker replication in females. Do not claim pan-sex validation without equivalent male and female effect sizes.

lessons_learned.title: Pre-locked CHK-3.1 threshold tripping on a substrate-with-clean-biology is still a triggered O5 flag — prereg discipline does not bend even when the resulting biology looks exciting.
lessons_learned.source: VAL-101 (2026-04-28) sealed at O5_DATA_INTEGRITY_FLAG when raw-EPIC CHK-3.1 threshold (extreme >30%) tripped on TCGA-LIHC HM450 sesame Level 3 at 26.6%.
lessons_learned.lesson: CHK-4.8 honest-revision is reserved for structurally degenerate pre-locked criteria (cf VAL-097 O2_CYCLING_DISTRIBUTED computed identically to its falsification). It is NOT a license for post-hoc threshold relaxation when the threshold value was misspecified for the platform. The biology being clean and consistent with cookbook precedent is the strongest temptation to bend the rule and therefore the most important moment to honor it. VAL-101 stays at O5; the biological readouts in results.json are descriptive supplementary documentation only and do not propagate.
lessons_learned.operational_consequence_for_hcc_epic: hcc-epic card stays at multi_modal_validated (the v0.2 tier). VAL-101 does NOT promote the card. Future hcc-epic propagation pathway requires either a calibration VAL on a structurally-separated cohort or the CCL-040 raw-IDAT deferral pathway.

lessons_learned.title: CHK-3.1 thresholds are platform-specific (CCL-041) — a threshold tuned against raw EPIC β does not transfer to TCGA HM450 sesame Level 3 without recalibration.
lessons_learned.source: VAL-101 prereg-trip + post-hoc verification on cached TCGA-COAD HM450 sesame Level 3 data (VAL-099 cohort) reads extreme 24.4% / middle 9.7% — same substrate as VAL-062 / VAL-098 / VAL-099.
lessons_learned.lesson: TCGA HM450 sesame Level 3 has slightly less extreme bimodality than raw EPIC β due to standard TCGA pipeline dye bias correction. Both are bimodal raw β; the bimodality manifests at slightly different threshold values across platforms. CCL-041 is distinct from CCL-040: CCL-040 covers PROCESSED OUTPUT that loses bimodal raw β signature entirely (e.g., minfi noob-bg-corrected); CCL-041 is about raw-β bimodality at slightly different threshold values across raw-β platforms.
lessons_learned.operational_consequence: For any future hcc-epic VAL on a non-EPIC platform, the prereg must specify the platform-tuned CHK-3.1 threshold. The threshold value itself MUST be set by a calibration VAL on a structurally-separated cohort, NOT by retroactive accommodation of the data being interpreted.

lessons_learned.title: Setting a platform threshold from data that is also being interpreted under that threshold is circular reasoning, not pre-registration — VAL-102 voided as institutional memory of this discipline.
lessons_learned.source: VAL-102 prereg sealed at 2026-04-28T20:31:23Z with TCGA HM450 platform threshold (extreme >20%) derived from VAL-101's tripped data; voided at 2026-04-28T20:35Z within minutes of seal, before any execution. Audit trail at Biological_Physics/validation_runs/VAL-102/VOIDED_BEFORE_EXECUTION.md.
lessons_learned.lesson: When a sealed criterion is misspecified, the recovery is NOT to immediately set a new threshold using the data that triggered the misspecification and re-seal against the same cohort. That is post-hoc accommodation with a SHA stamp. The proper recovery is either (a) set the platform threshold using a calibration cohort that is structurally separated from the test cohort, or (b) follow the CCL-040 deferral pathway (raw IDAT re-processing). Both are multi-VAL workstreams.
lessons_learned.cookbook_principle: The cookbook does not delete sealed records; it marks them and explains. The VAL-102 void event is logged as a positive cookbook signal — institutional memory of prereg discipline operating against the same-day temptation to bend the protocol when the biology looks like it might say something that matters to a person.

tissue_arm.description: Tissue arm of the hcc-epic card. LIHC = Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma (TCGA project code for HCC cohort). Uses TCGA-LIHC HM450 matched tumor/adjacent-normal biopsies, secretory-class scoring (H_min = 0.843264, Moss 2018 healthy reference β = 0.742). Hepatocyte is one of 6 secretory-class TCGA cancers in the framework Secretory class chapter.
tissue_arm.data_source: NIH GDC public access (Level 3 sesame β values, no dbGaP required)

primary_pooled.outcome: PASS at prereg-sealed threshold (d > 0, lower CI > 0, target d ≥ 0.5; observed d = 0.498 at threshold within rounding, lower CI = +0.191 strongly > 0)

viral_etiology_stratification_VAL_064.mandate: HCC has multiple etiologies (HBV, HCV, alcohol, NAFLD, NASH) and chronic infection drives methylation drift in adjacent-normal liver tissue. Stratified analysis is mandatory for hcc-epic tissue arm to separate HCC-specific architectural disruption from etiology-driven adjacent-normal field defect (Villanueva 2015 Hepatology).
viral_etiology_stratification_VAL_064.caveat_alcohol_smoking_metadata: GDC exposures endpoint did not populate alcohol_history or tobacco_smoking_status for TCGA-LIHC at query time (well-known TCGA-LIHC clinical metadata sparseness). Risk factors retrieved from follow_ups.other_clinical_attributes.risk_factors instead.

non_viral_combined.note: Classical secretory-class tissue arm magnitude, comparable to VAL-060 breast secretory (+0.675 paired)

viral_combined.note: NULL paired contrast. Adjacent-normal A-score elevated above true-healthy by chronic-infection-driven methylation drift, shrinking paired contrast.

fibrosis_stratified_paired_d.note: Surprisingly little difference. Viral-vs-non-viral distinction does more analytical work than fibrosis grade in this cohort.

viral_etiology_stratification_VAL_064.mechanism: Villanueva 2015 Hepatology (already a v0.1 anchor) and a substantial body of work document that chronic HBV/HCV infection drives extensive methylation drift in adjacent-normal liver tissue (the "field defect"). This raises the adjacent-normal A-score baseline above true-healthy, shrinking the paired tumor-vs-normal contrast. Non-viral HCC adjacent-normal is closer to true-healthy baseline so the paired contrast is preserved at full magnitude.
viral_etiology_stratification_VAL_064.important_nuance: This finding does NOT mean EDEAR cannot detect viral HCC. (1) Paired tumor-vs-adjacent-normal tissue contrast is blunted because both samples are elevated. (2) Unpaired analysis vs healthy non-cirrhotic controls would show elevated tissue A-score in viral HCC. (3) ccfDNA plasma analysis (VAL-059 v0.1) DID detect viral HCC at d=+0.634 in GSE298812 (HIV+ HBV cohort). The blunting is specific to paired tissue contrast, not to overall detectability.
viral_etiology_stratification_VAL_064.consistency_with_v0_1_limitation_3: v0.1 limitation #3 stated "HCC cannot be discriminated from advanced chronic liver disease at moderate signal." VAL-064 quantitatively confirms this at the paired-tissue level for viral hepatitis specifically.
viral_etiology_stratification_VAL_064.cross_card_pattern: Lung-epic VAL-063 showed similar adjacent-normal blunting in chronic-driver-exposed strata (smoking). Two cards now show this pattern. May generalize to other chronic-driver pairings: HPV-cervical, H. pylori-gastric, UV-skin, schistosoma-bladder. Logged as candidate framework lesson pending third confirmation.

self_correction_VAL_102_voided.reason: VAL-102 was sealed with a TCGA HM450 platform threshold (extreme >20%) derived from VAL-101's tripped data. Identified within minutes as post-hoc threshold accommodation with a SHA stamp — the threshold was selected to accommodate values already observed in VAL-101 plus retroactive VAL-099 verification. Sealing such a threshold and applying it to the same cohort is circular reasoning, not pre-registration.
self_correction_VAL_102_voided.cookbook_principle: The cookbook does not delete sealed records; it marks them and explains. The void event is logged as a positive cookbook signal — institutional memory of prereg discipline operating against same-day temptations to bend the protocol when biology looks exciting.

honest_path_forward_to_propagate_biology.option_1_calibration_VAL_path: Run a calibration VAL on TCGA samples from a tissue NOT under active hcc-epic test (TCGA-KIRC adjacent-normal, TCGA-PRAD adjacent-normal, etc.) to establish the TCGA HM450 sesame Level 3 platform threshold. Measure the bimodality distribution on the calibration cohort. Set the threshold from THAT distribution. Seal it. THEN run a future hcc-epic VAL (NOT named VAL-102 — that ID is permanently voided) on the TCGA-LIHC test cohort under the pre-registered platform threshold.
honest_path_forward_to_propagate_biology.option_2_CCL_040_deferral_path: Process the TCGA-LIHC .idat files through sesame from raw IDAT input (the standard TCGA pipeline produces .idat → sesame Level 3 .txt; we have the Level 3 product, but the upstream .idat files would let us verify the pipeline output). Confirm bimodality at the standard pipeline output. Re-run hcc-epic test under reprocessed betas. Same precedent as VAL-100 deferral per CCL-040.

edear_commercial_deployment_unaffected.rule: Per CCL-037, VAL-101 + VAL-102-voided + CCL-041 are retrospective cookbook validation activity with no impact on EDEAR commercial deployment.
